chip: Hailo-8 (Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ 26 TOPS, PCIe Gen3 x1)

model.hef: model.hailo8.hef (Hailo Model Zoo all_minilm_l6_v2, v2.19.0, INT8)
model.front_end: word (raw word-embedding gather; position/token-type/LayerNorm inside the HEF; additive -1e4 attention mask input)

command: cargo test -p turboembed --features hailo --test hailo_minilm -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1 && cargo run -p turboembed --features hailo --release --example hailo_bench

quality.note: INT8 + fixed-128-frame compression moves absolute cosine vs FP32; ranking is the honest quality metric and is near-parity. Tokenizer parity with HF tokenizers verified id-for-id on the unicode golden text.

performance.note: HEF is batch-1 with a fixed 128-token frame, so throughput is flat in text length and batch rows loop on the host. hailortcli run reports 74.46 FPS on the same HEF (random data).
